column1: # Grammar forks carried by rinch-ce. Source of truth for scripts/grammar-forks.sh.
# We maintain these branches ourselves rather than upstreaming. Each fork is
# branched from the tag of its published crates.io version — never master — so
# the patch changes the build script (and, for html/markdown, a C scanner) and
# nothing about the grammar itself.
# crate            The crates.io package name. This is what [patch.crates-io] keys on.
# upstream         Where the grammar actually lives.
# fork             Our fork. Note it is named after the REPO, which for toml and
#                  markdown differs from the crate name.
# tag              Upstream tag our patch currently applies to.
# patch            File in this directory, named after the repo.
# crate
tree-sitter-rust
tree-sitter-typescript
tree-sitter-javascript
tree-sitter-json
tree-sitter-html
tree-sitter-toml-ng
tree-sitter-yaml
tree-sitter-md
